title: This play also has my new favorite stage direction ever #fatham #broa...
transcript: I don't know what I need to do or say on this app that I haven't already done in order to convince you that you need to go see Fat Ham, but the fact that it is currently the lowest grossing play on Broadway during Pride Month is frankly homophobic. And it was Juneteenth weekend, so it's also anti black. It is one of the best shows I've seen. It was my favorite show that I saw all of last year. I went out and bought the play. It is that good. Everybody that I know that has seen it, that I told to see it, has loved it afterwards. I don't know how to convince you to believe me, but it's really that good. I also think this is really good starter play if you mostly see musicals and don't see a lot of straight plays. Granted, this is the farthest thing from straight, but it's really that good. And it's not even that expensive. They do offer a rush through today takes, but also you can get full price tickets for every single day left in the run for under $100. And this is not a sponsored post. Today takes an eye on thin ice. They did not invite me to the Theater Camp premiere and I couldn't have gone anyways. But it's the thought that count. Literally, they've been running sales for the entire run of Fat Ham. And bonus you get one of the best pride bills On Broadway right now. If you've already seen it, please send this to somebody who hasn't to convince them to go, because we need to sell out these final 2 weeks. I do not at all work for the show, but I swear it is too good to be this low in the grosses. It is depressing me.
